packet.evidence_limit: A matching number and unit provide evidence of this calculation on this item. They leave boundary selection, reasoning, source interpretation, practical operation, laboratory competence and independent design unassessed. The survey samples a discipline. Multicomponent separations, chemical applications of kinetics and supervised laboratory work require additional study.
packet.goal: I want to learn chemical engineering
packet.learner: Can we do another tank problem? This time I'd like to explain how I picked the sign before you tell me if I got it.

material.excerpt: The total budget as printed in the output does not include internal flows between model cells
material.practice: A 5 kg transfer leaves the left basin and enters the right, with both covered and no other transfers. Draw separate boundaries and then one combined boundary. Which of the three inventories changed?
material.worked: Two indoor pools exchange 7 kg of water. Both lie inside the boundary. A delivery adds 3 kg from outside and a drain carries 1 kg away. The paired pools gain 2 kg during the interval.

packet.new_task: Two covered basins together contain 25 kg of water at the start of an interval. The delivery log records 2 kg entering from outside. A maintenance log records 11 kg moved from the west basin to the east basin. An outlet collects 8 kg outside the pair. These are all water movements. For one boundary enclosing both basins, report the signed change in total inventory over the interval. Enter a signed whole number followed by kg.
packet.policy: Show the exact saved focus if available. Ask for the new problem excerpt and whether the focus applies. If confirmed and supported by the excerpt, use both to select the quantity decision to teach. Otherwise, ask which quantity decision the learner wants help with and use their answer with the excerpt. If context is missing, ask for the relevant portion. Follow the teaching sequence starting with the unaided attempt. Apply the same approval rule to any memory update.

response.display: Your saved focus is “choice.” I have the new two-basin problem. Does that focus apply to how you chose the sign? Try the problem on your own first. Tell me what led you to pick your sign, then give your signed whole number followed by kg. I’ll wait for your explanation before giving feedback.
